name: Pleats: Hinge Accordion
subtitle: Play accordion on iPhone Duo
promo: Made for iPhone Duo: open and close the hinge and the bellows breathe. A real, playable accordion with bass chords, registers and songs that teach you to play.
description:
Pleats turns iPhone Duo into an accordion. Hold it like a book, half open: the fold is the bellows. Open and close the hinge to pump air, press the buttons, and the reeds sing.

A REAL INSTRUMENT
• Pressure comes from how fast you move the bellows: a slow pull is soft, a quick push is loud. Both directions sound, as on a real accordion.
• Treble buttons on one half, Stradella bass and chord buttons on the other. Play melody, bass notes and chords together with as many fingers as you like.
• Chromatic five-row button board, or a diatonic G/C push–pull board where every button plays a different note on the push and on the pull.

REEDS, NOT SAMPLES
Every note is synthesized live from detuned reeds, with a natural attack, breath and a warm room. Switch registers like on a real instrument: Clarinet, Bandoneon and the wet, shimmering Musette.

LEARN SONGS
Pick a song and the next button lights up. Play it with air and the song moves on, at your own pace. Or choose Listen and Pleats plays it for you first. Earn up to three stars per song. From Ode to Joy and a sea shanty to Üsküdar'a Gider İken, plus an original musette waltz.

RECORD
Record a clip of your playing and listen back.

CRAFTED
Black lacquer or ivory finish, mother-of-pearl buttons, brass trim and pleated bellows that open with the hinge. Haptics follow the air and every button.

ON EVERY IPHONE AND IPAD
No hinge? Drag the bellows strip in the middle like real bellows, or turn on Easy air and just press the buttons.

FAIR
The instrument, three registers and nine songs are free, with no ads and no account. One optional purchase, Pleats Pro, adds five more registers, three more voices, ten more songs and sharing of recordings. No subscription, and it works with Family Sharing.
